chunks: And from him, with this chain of narration, he said:
The hand is not cut except for one who breaches a house or breaks a lock.

key_terms.بَيْتًا: a house or dwelling from which property is taken
key_terms.نَقَبَ: broke through or breached by making an opening for entry
key_terms.يُقْطَعُ: the legal punishment of cutting, referring here to amputation as a hadd penalty

ai.seo_question: When is the hadd punishment of amputation applied in cases of theft according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal ruling concerning the hadd for theft, restricting amputation to a case involving forced unlawful entry such as breaching a house or breaking a lock. It indicates that not every act of taking property qualifies for this specific legal punishment.
